test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Ramu invested some money at 8% simple interest per annum, and it was grown up to Rs. 820 in 8 years. If the same sum was invested at 20% simple interest per annum for a period of 10 years, find the amount.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) at 8% = Amount (A) - Interest (SI)

Amount (A) = ₹820

Time (t) = 8 years

Rate (r) = 8%

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × r × t / 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

**Calculations:**

820 = P + (P × 8 × 8 / 100)
